checkedBy: script — every step re-found in poppler's own reading of the page

steps.text: Check the filters for residue after each wash.
Turn the coarse filter counterclockwise and remove the filter system.
notes: Ensure that foreign objects do not fall into the sump.

steps.text: Pull down the micro filter to remove.
Press the locking catches together and lift the coarse filter out.
Clean the filter elements under running water.
notes: Carefully remove the rim of debris between the coarse filter and the fine filter.

steps.text: Put the filter system back together.
notes: Ensure that the locking catches on the coarse filter click into position.

steps.text: Insert the filter system into the appliance and turn the coarse filter clockwise.
notes: Ensure that the arrow markings match up.
